base: 90b9083433 (origin/mvp/spec-29 tip at the time of the run; no later commits to merge)
defect: A real-provider Session interrupted by Host SIGTERM reopened its worker automatically after relaunch while its history refused reads with SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED (gateway/internal); every index regeneration was refused as outcome_unknown/SESSION_EXIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and a manual open could not recover the view.
rootCauses: packages/sessions/presentation-service.ts auto-opened a worker from every read when the supervisor answered SESSION_MANUAL_OPEN_REQUIRED, so page load resurrected interrupted Sessions without owner consent.

apps/host/src/session-component-server.ts probed supervisor.assertObjectAccess inside current() for session/follow and converted the typed manual-open refusal into the literal SESSION_AUTH_REQUIRED, which the gateway masked as gateway/internal.

packages/sessions/index.ts only re-marked opening/open attempts at Host startup, so an attempt the dying Host had observed as outcome_unknown/SESSION_EXIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN carried no restart marker or manual-reopen instruction.
The frozen stock shell has no explicit Open control, so no affordance could answer the marker.
changes: packages/sessions/index.ts: outcome_unknown attempts also become outcome_unknown/SESSION_HOST_RESTARTED_MANUAL_OPEN_REQUIRED at Host startup.
packages/sessions/presentation-service.ts: reads never open; the typed manual-open condition propagates to the client.
apps/host/src/session-component-server.ts: follow admission is auth-only; typed Session errors cross the wire through sessionFailure instead of gateway/internal.

apps/chat/src/product-enrollment.js: Sessions sidebar action and overlay listing authorized Sessions with their attempt marker and an explicit Open Session control (public ompSessions.index/catalog/open; no replay).
